title: Fiscal Year 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena October 2023
doc_notes: This document is the Fiscal Year 2023 Consolidated Annual Report on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena produced by the ODNI and DoD, providing an overview of AARO's reporting statistics and program updates.

incidents.summary: Military personnel reported five equidistant lights in restricted airspace, which were later identified as commercial aircraft.
behavior: flew at a relatively constant pace
incidents.explanation: Commercial aircraft travelling on well-established air corridors up to 300 nautical miles from the platform.
incidents.quote: Military personnel reported seeing five equidistant lights that they believed represented a potential incursion into restricted military airspace.
